visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a messy living room, a cartoon character in a yellow hoodie sits on a green couch playing video games surrounded by trash and snack bags. A pink-haired girl walks into the frame from the right with a visible frown and furrowed brows, looking angry. (2) The girl stands at a sink washing dishes with a grumpy expression while the background shows a messy kitchen area. Suddenly, the scene cuts to a dark background where the yellow character appears under a bright yellow spotlight, holding a red rose in his mouth and striking a confident pose. (3) Back in the living room, the yellow character vacuums a dirty, gray rug while winking at the camera and maintaining a flirtatious facial expression. The pink-haired girl watches him from the side with her arms crossed, her expression softening. (4) The scene shifts to a bathroom where the yellow character is seen interacting with a toilet, dramatically cleaning it and striking poses as if he were a model. (5) In a bedroom setting, the yellow character dramatically folds laundry and winks while holding up a pair of pink socks. (6) The pink-haired girl's eyes turn into large hearts, and she clasps her hands together in excitement. (7) The yellow character is seen pole dancing on a litter scooper while cleaning a cat litter box, while a white cat with a unicorn horn looks on. He then hangs upside down from a bar to throw a bag into a trash bin. (8) The two characters embrace in the living room as the girl hugs the yellow character tightly. (9) A final screen appears displaying a collection of digital stickers featuring the yellow character in various emotional poses and text overlays.
